snippet.title: New Super Lucky’s Tale | PlayStation 5 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🦊 Lucky’s joyful globe trotting adventure is coming to PlayStation 5 on 26 March 2026. ✨

New Super Lucky’s Tale arrives on PS5 beautifully enhanced, offering smoother performance crisp visuals and immersive DualSense features that make every jump spin and discovery feel better than ever.

Developed by Playful Studios and published by PQube, this PS5 release keeps the heart charm and personality players love while delivering a more responsive and comfortable way to play.

Whether you are meeting Lucky for the first time or returning for another adventure, this is a wonderful way to explore colourful worlds tackle playful challenges and uncover hidden secrets.

PS5 features include:
 • Up to 120fps gameplay
 • 4K support
 • DualSense controller features
 • Physical edition available

✨ New Super Lucky’s Tale launches on PlayStation 5 on 26 March 2026, find out more: https://pqube.co.uk/games/new-super-luckys-tale/ 🦊
